rows.definicion_documentada: 14. Equity-to-TDC Policy:Equity-to-TDC is calculated as total equity required through stabilization divided by true all-in TDC. The metric is used to test capital efficiency and financing support. For Underwriten, a preferred equity requirement is generally in the 20%–25% range when supported by market debt and sustainable refinance economics; however, lower equity does not automatically improve the underwriting classification because it may simply reflect excessive leverage.A clean PASS should generally require Equity-to-TDC at or below 35% in Base and 40% in Downside. A Base Case above 45% is considered economically unattractive for the strategy and should be classified as FAIL – DO NOT PURSUE unless an explicitly documented alternative capitalization structure changes the economics.Equity below 25% of TDC must not be treated as automatically superior. The model must verify that the resulting construction leverage is market-supported and that permanent refinancing remains supportable under both LTV and DSCR.

Levered IRR Policy:Levered IRR is calculated on project-level equity cash flows using the actual timing of equity contributions, operating distributions, refinance proceeds and exit or terminal value assumptions applicable to the strategy. IRR must be evaluated together with Equity Multiple, equity recovery, Equity-to-TDC and Downside performance.

rows.definicion_documentada: 17. Verdict Rules Policy:HOLD – MORE DD REQUIRED:Material information required to support the investment conclusion is missing, unresolved or materially uncertain. This classification overrides an economic PASS when the missing information could materially affect cost, revenue, financing, valuation or equity returns.FAIL – DO NOT PURSUE:Any applicable Base Case metric breaches its defined FAIL threshold, or the project cannot support the required economics at the current purchase price / JV structure. The Mini-UW must still identify the Maximum Supportable Purchase Price or the economic condition required to make the project potentially investable.PASS – PROCEED TO FULL UW:Every applicable Base and Downside metric meets its PASS threshold, no material DD deficiency capable of changing the conclusion remains unresolved, and the project does not depend on Upside assumptions to pass.HOLD – ECONOMICS NOT SUPPORTED:The project does not breach a FAIL threshold but one or more applicable Base or Downside PASS thresholds are not met. The Mini-UW must identify the principal economic deficiency and the purchase price, cost, revenue, financing or structural condition required for the project to pass.General rule:Only metrics applicable to the project strategy may trigger PASS / HOLD / FAIL. A metric that is not applicable to the strategy must be treated as N/A and must not cause an automatic failure. Upside assumptions may never rescue a weak Base Case.
